description: Restore a session without resuming its conversation: the same id, bib, name, cwd and command start again in a new tmux session, and the record leaves session.restorable. Harness deviation: TOGO_HOME holds the record of one Claude Code session that a host restart ended: id s_abcdefghij, bib 01, command claude --model opus, cwd <home>/proj, created 2026-11-03T10:00:00Z, ended 2026-11-03T11:30:00Z, with a conversation the agent can resume; no tmux session exists for it. The login-shell PATH holds an executable claude that waits at its prompt until killed.
